relational_final.l2_n_unit: training pairs (one difference row per pair)

pointwise_final.objective: mean BCE(x.w + b, y) + 0.5*|w|^2/n, intercept unregularized
pointwise_final.l2_n_unit: training responses (chosen and rejected rows of each training pair)

relational_all4.l2_n_unit: training pairs (one difference row per pair)

pointwise_all4.objective: mean BCE(x.w + b, y) + 0.5*|w|^2/n, intercept unregularized
pointwise_all4.l2_n_unit: training responses (chosen and rejected rows of each training pair)

surface_logistic.l2_n_unit: training pairs (one difference row per pair)

columns.hh_train_index: row of the Anthropic/hh-rlhf train split
columns.label: always 1: the human-preferred (chosen) reply is the first member; a positive pair score is correct, 0 is a tie (1/2)
columns.identical_after_left_truncation: 1 if the two replies' pooled states are identical (identical texts)
columns.pointwise_*_chosen / _rejected: w.h + b for each reply; the pair score is chosen minus rejected; per-reply accuracy counts chosen > 0 and rejected <= 0
columns.length_rule / norm_final_rule: sign_from_train * (chosen - rejected) of untruncated token count / last-loop state norm
columns.surface_logistic: w.(differences in token count and the four loop norms, divided by train std)
